mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stores (code, name, address, phone, tin, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{tin}, #{active})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stores ORDER BY name
mapper.update: UPDATE stores SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, tin = #{tin} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stores SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
